about_short_description.short_description: CAPIX is a global provider of software solutions for Treasury, Cash Management and Risk Management.

product.name: CAPIX Treasury Manager (CTM)
product.description: A Microsoft Windows-based multi-user treasury system for small to medium corporate treasuries, supporting trading and cash management of various financial instruments.

product.name: CAPIX Treasury Centre (CTC)
product.description: An enterprise-scale Microsoft Windows-based treasury system for larger treasury operations, supporting a broad range of financial securities and cash management.

product.name: CAPIX Investment Manager (CIM)
product.description: A Microsoft Windows-based treasury system tailored for small to medium investment managers, supporting trading and cash management of various financial instruments.

product.name: CAPIX Cloud Treasury (CCT)
product.description: A cloud-based treasury system on Microsoft Azure for corporate treasury operations, supporting trading and cash management of various financial instruments.

product.name: AI Cashflow Forecasting Module
product.description: An AI-driven cashflow forecasting solution integrating ERP data to provide multi-horizon liquidity predictions with confidence intervals for multinational treasury operations.

product.name: Professional Services
product.description: Consulting, analysis, project management, software customization, and contract software engineering related to treasury and capital markets technology.
